_comment: Example configuration for Scholar Agent. Copy to .scholar.json and customize.
_paperpulse_comment: PaperPulse cloud sync. paperpulse_token is the short-lived login JWT: it guards the loopback endpoints (/import-markdown, /graph) via 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and authenticates 'scholar-agent graph sync'. No refresh flow — when it expires, log in to PaperPulse again and paste the new token here. Leave empty to restrict the loopback server to loopback origins/peers only.

unified_pipeline._comment: Daily recommendation pipeline. reject_dedup_days: candidates rejected by the LLM review stay out of the pool for this many days (default 14), then re-enter.

research_interests._comment: Per-domain 'priority' (default 1.0) weights that domain's fit contribution relative to your highest-priority domain — the top domain scores at full weight, lower-priority domains proportionally less.
